verdict.rationale: Proa ships a first-party full-stack layer over its core rendering crate. `proa new site` scaffolds an Axum-backed app, and routes are registered in a generator-maintained `src/routes.rs` and inspected with `proa site routes`, with per-route page caching. Data fetching comes through typed request-scoped data, route state and loader caching via WebContext, plus streaming Suspense for slow data. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the loader/data-fetching API (only one-line mentions), any explicit statement that the site layer is a distinct meta-framework on top of proa_core, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
